changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 1: tsconfig.json now sets compilerOptions.types to an empty array (bans every @types/node ambient global, not just NodeJS/Buffer) and src/index.ts's root barrel switched from per-name export type {...} blocks to one export type * per module. Verified with the TypeScript checker that the resolved public export set (123 names) is byte-identical before and after; no runtime or published-API change.
